items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: the trombone player was Nat Story, that was the brass section.

ctx.x: Norman Mason played trumpet and sax. Sax, yeah, he's a very good eccentric man, and in the brass section had Albert Snire, and they had a fellow, Albert Snire on trumpet, and another fellow, he's in Chicago now, he was a very good reader, but he never could take a hot chorus, and the trombone player was Nat Story, that was the brass section.
And another, the trumpet you say was a, never could take a hot chorus?
